    """Fill a rectangular shape's interior with concentric rings cycling colors [2,5,0,5] by depth; a leftover center of at most 2x2 takes the next cycle color, a 3x3 center keeps its cycle-colored border and gets a filled middle cell only from ring depth 3 on."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    coords=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=0]
    top=min(i for i,_ in coords)+1; bot=max(i for i,_ in coords)-1
    left=min(j for _,j in coords)+1; right=max(j for _,j in coords)-1
    cycle=[2,5,0,5]; d=0
    while bot-top+1>3 and right-left+1>3:
        c=cycle[d%4]
        for j in range(left,right+1): g[top][j]=c; g[bot][j]=c
        for i in range(top,bot+1): g[i][left]=c; g[i][right]=c
        top+=1; bot-=1; left+=1; right-=1; d+=1
    w=right-left+1; h=bot-top+1
    if w<=2 and h<=2:
        c=cycle[d%4]
        for i in range(top,bot+1):
